evidence: Modifies `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and internal CI cache actions to run native macOS arm64 CI tests on cross-compiled binaries.
rationale: Closes a major gap in CI platform testing by executing cross-built macOS binaries natively. As noted in the description, cross-compiled macOS binaries were previously unexecuted in CI, allowing platform-specific crashes like #35771 to reach release branches.
